messages.subject: Odd persp error
parts:
Here's one I can't seem to figure out.  I'm trying to use persp to make a 3d plot in a beamer frame.  But no matter what, I get the error:

Error in sum(figs) : invalud 'type" (list) of argument

Here is an example frame that will produce this error.  What's going on here?

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
\begin{frame}[fragile]
<<a, echo=FALSE>>=
x <- seq(-10, 10, length= 30)
y <- x
f <- function(x,y) { r <- sqrt(x^2+y^2); 10 * sin(r)/r }
z <- outer(x, y, f)
z[is.na(z)] <- 1
op <- par(bg = "white")
persp(x, y, z, theta = 30, phi = 30, expand = 0.5, col = "lightblue")
 
@
\end{frame}
